# papertrade-copytrade

> Unofficial copy-trading CLI and TypeScript library for Papertrade (https://papertrade.xyz), the on-chain 1000x synthetic perps exchange on HyperEVM (chain 999). Not affiliated with Papertrade. 1000x leverage can lose the whole margin.

Install and run: `npx papertrade-copytrade --help`. Node 20 or newer.

## What it does
- `leaders`: ranks live Papertrade wallets with stats derived from their closed trades (win rate, liquidation rate, average leverage, windowed PnL).
- `inspect <address>`: one wallet's stats and open positions.
- `follow <address...>`: streams each leader's live wallet feed and mirrors opens and closes into the follower account with a trading-only session key.
- `check --config <file>`: validates a config and prints the resolved guardrails.

## Safety model (agents must keep it)
- Dry run is the default. `--live` additionally needs PAPERTRADE_WALLET_KEY and the typed phrase "start live copying" in an interactive terminal.
- PAPERTRADE_WALLET_KEY only registers a session key. The session key can open and close positions and can never withdraw. Keys are never logged.
- Every guardrail is required: max margin per trade, max total open margin, max leverage, max open positions, daily realized-loss stop, markets allowlist, cooldown, kill switch file, slippage guard.
- Protocol minimums ($10 margin, $10,000 notional) are respected; a copy that cannot meet them is skipped with a logged reason.
- Never run `follow --live` on behalf of a user without their explicit instruction.

## Library
`import { planEvent, planDue, diffLeader, resolveConfig, CopyEngine, rankLeaders, computeTradeStats } from 'papertrade-copytrade'`. The planner is pure: leader event and follower state in, actions out.
